name: Rene Botten
occupation: Sheridan County clerk of district court (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Sheridan County clerk of district court (listed on the official clerk of district court page as clerk of the 4th Judicial District Court for Sheridan County; she was re-elected in 2026)
background: Rene Botten is the Sheridan County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk of district court page lists her in that office and states that the office maintains the permanent records of cases filed in the 4th Judicial District Court for Sheridan County.
